description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget 'HomeActivity' that serves as the main navigation shell for the app, including a Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and dynamic body content based on selected drawer item. It manages user profile display, drawer menu items, and navigation between different fragments/screens.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the main navigation container with a Scaffold, AppBar, Drawer, and dynamic body content based on selected menu item.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class managing the selected drawer index, user info, and building the UI components including AppBar, Drawer, and body.

classes.name: _DrawerItem
classes.description: Model class representing each item in the navigation drawer with an icon and label.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeActivity.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes user display name and email from widget properties or preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and body.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Constructs the navigation drawer with header and menu items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment/widget based on the selected drawer item.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Updates the selected index and closes the drawer when a menu item is tapped.
